name: @gamepark/cites-royales-app
description: The user interface of Cités Royales adaptation for Game Park
author: Romain Fromi <romain@game-park.com> (https://game-park.com/)

scripts.sync:hashed: rclone copy dist cites-royales:cites-royales.game-park.com --progress --s3-acl=public-read --include "assets/**" -M --metadata-set "cache-control=public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
scripts.sync:clean: rclone sync dist cites-royales:cites-royales.game-park.com --progress --s3-acl=public-read --include "assets/**" -M --metadata-set "cache-control=public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
scripts.sync: npx rimraf dist/assets/*.map && yarn sync:hashed && yarn sync:other && yarn sync:clean
scripts.deploy: yarn build && node -e "if(process.env.DATADOG_API_KEY){require('child_process').execSync('yarn upload-sourcemaps',{stdio:'inherit'})}" && yarn sync
